title: Independent large-scale confirmation of the repaired PX-050 package-install gate
relationship_to_px050w: PX-050W was a one-million-row discovery run. It had zero invalid allows but failed its exact-decision check on eight npm names beginning with two hyphens. The parser was repaired to distinguish its two generated valueless flags from registry package names, and this confirmation uses a fresh seed.
primary_question: On an independently seeded one-million-command corpus, does the repaired frozen gate block every invalid or unsafe command and allow every supported safe-valid command?

source_artifact.paper: We Have a Package for You! A Comprehensive Analysis of Package Hallucinations by Code Generating LLMs

corpus.generation: Identical frozen generator and six command families used by PX-050W, with seed 50051 instead of 50050.

claim_if_passed: Across a failed discovery run and an independently seeded confirmatory run totaling two million commands, the repaired PX-050 gate demonstrated large-scale robustness within the frozen PyPI/npm registries, supported command grammar, and preregistered mutation families.
forbidden_claims: Detection of malicious packages that exist in a registry
Robustness to arbitrary shell programs or unsupported package managers
Direct replication of the paper's withheld 576,000 per-prompt outputs
Temporal validity beyond the frozen artifact registry snapshot
